interaction.formula: event ~ contains_7 * C(state) + pair_delta_theta_cum_pre + time_scaled + time2 + batch2
interaction.state_task_confound: theta1 corresponds to incoming T2 and theta2 corresponds to incoming T3. State and incoming task are therefore perfectly confounded in this comparison.
interaction.interpretation: The interaction tests heterogeneity of the expert-7 timing association between the two checkpoint/task conditions. It does not isolate a pure checkpoint-state effect and does not establish causality.
interaction.reason: At least one state was below the 15-crossing-per-batch floor.

scientific_constraints.theta0_anchor_limitation: theta0 is task-0 state and is used as the common historical functional anchor. At theta2 this does not encode the task-1 state.
scientific_constraints.state_task_confound: theta1/T2 and theta2/T3 move together, so state × contains_7 cannot distinguish checkpoint state from incoming task.
scientific_constraints.causality: The closure/hazard association is not a causality test.
